Name: CP Crows
Author: stardewforest
Description:
[b]1.6 update - uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to have crows as a unique coop animal [/b][b][b]♡ [/b]![/b]

[b]features [/b][b][b]♡ [/b][/b]
- purchase crows from marnie for 1200 gold
- grey eyed variant

choice between two versions:
- crows produce drift wood and broken glasses
- crows produce drift wood and pearls


[b]1.5 update - please use BFAV unofficial update for 1.5 by kelvinparkour found [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296?tab=posts]here in the comment thread of Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety[/url]

[b]features[/b] ♡
- grey eyed variant
- crows produce drift wood and pearls
- purchase from marnie for 800 gold

[b]install ♡[/b]
- unzip and place file into mods folder


[b]1.5 requires[/b]  |  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296]Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety (BFAV)[/url] 's unofficial update for 1.5 ( [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296?tab=posts]available here[/url]  - scroll through comments to find )
